newsitem.title: UK: Russia overseas shares steady on Yeltsin op.
newsitem.headline: Russia overseas shares steady on Yeltsin op.

text.p: Russian shares traded overseas were steady in thin trade in London as President Boris Yeltsin went under the knife for his heart operation. "People are just relieved that the operation has actually started," said a trader in London.
American Depositary Shares in oil and gas giant Gazprom, which last month undertook Russia's largest international share offer, was trading two cents higher at $17.40/$17.90 by 1100 GMT.
"Unlike most emerging markets which are volatility plays, Russia is one to hold for the medium term," said a European fund manager.
Oil company LUKoil American Depositary Receipts were at $40.50/$41.50, electricity utility Mosenergo ADRs quoted at $28.75/$29.75, while department store GUM ADRs were at $45.00/$49.00.
